name: Mitesh
_notes: Brand identity: MiteshJourney — Learn • Build • Explore • Grow. Positioning: Personal educational technology creator covering AI, software development, programming, developer tools, automation, productivity and practical learning. Brand palette: Deep Navy #0B1220 (primary background), Electric Blue #2563EB (primary accent), Cyan #06B6D4 (secondary accent), Amber #F59E0B (highlights and CTA), Violet #8B5CF6 (AI and creative accents), Off-white #F8FAFC (text). Typography: Inter or Sora, bold headlines and clean readable body text. Visual style: Premium, minimal, modern, intelligent, cinematic and technology-focused. Creator appearance: Use uploaded face reference, rectangular glasses, natural hairstyle and beard; prefer crisp white shirt, navy blazer or navy casual jacket. Maintain consistent facial identity and realistic proportions. Video format: 9:16 vertical, strong 0–3 second hook, fast kinetic typography, word-level voice synchronization, clear numbered sections, real screen recordings, code demonstrations, animated UI cards and evidence-based claims. Use subtle whoosh, pop and tick sound effects. Keep captions readable and high contrast. Use deep navy for dark layouts and light grey for educational listicles. Apply electric blue to important words, cyan for technology highlights and amber sparingly for emphasis. Keep the @MiteshJourney watermark small and consistent. Content tone: Practical, confident, friendly, educational and easy to understand. CTA: Follow-only. Never promise an ebook, resource or download unless it actually exists. cta.type options: follow | comment-keyword | none. Use comment-keyword only when the promised resource is available.
